name: Kiwi-Grape Tofu Overnight Oats
description: A high-protein, creamy breakfast. Blend the **tofu** and **milk** (and a splash of kombucha for tang) until smooth. Mix the blended base with the **oats**. Layer or top with sliced **kiwi** and halved **grapes**. Refrigerate overnight. The tofu provides a thickness similar to yogurt, and the oats absorb the liquid for a quick, grab-and-go meal.

name: Savory Tofu & Veggie Bowl with Avocado-Kombucha Dressing
description: A fresh and savory meal. **Steam or warm the tofu and veggies** together. Make a creamy dressing by blending the **avocado** with a few tablespoons of **kombucha**, a dash of **soy sauce**, **rice vinegar**, and salt/pepper until smooth. Drizzle the dressing generously over the tofu and vegetables. Serve warm or cold.

name: Tofu-Avocado Mash on Toast with Fruit Salad
ingredients: Salt, Pepper, and Lemon Juice (Recommended extras)
description: A two-part, balanced meal. For the savory component, mash the **avocado** and crumble in some firm **tofu**, seasoning with salt, pepper, and lemon juice. Spread on toast (if available) and serve alongside the **steamed veggies**. For the sweet side, toss the **kiwi** and **grapes** together and top with **oats** mixed with a splash of **milk** for a quick fruit salad.
